_comment: Example business context. Copy this to config.json and edit it for your own business. config.json is gitignored so your real details never get committed. All values below are generic examples, not any real company's data.
code_guide: Stock codes follow: Category | Code | Description | Type1 | Type2. Metal prefixes: G=Gold, S=Silver, P=Platinum, PA=Palladium. Country codes: US, A=Austrian, M=Mexican, B=British, C=Canadian. A REPO suffix marks a buyback item; MISC marks miscellaneous. Example: G5L63 = Gold US $5 Liberty, MS-63 grade.
accounting_rules: IRS Form 8300 required for cash transactions over $10,000 (file within 15 days)
Consignment inventory tracked separately and kept off the balance sheet
Graded coins carry a numismatic premium above melt value
